strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{NEWLINE}你要到几楼呢？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hello.{SCROLL}To which floor may I take you? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 已经到达{NEWLINE}您要前往的楼层了。
strings.en: We have already arrived at your floor.
strings.notes: US 0500/4 | RV023: meaning: plain statement, not a confused question

strings.en: First floor has the Service Counter{NEWLINE}and the main entrance.

strings.zh: ２楼是有很多好东西的{NEWLINE}训练师专柜。
strings.en: Second floor has the Trainer’s Market{NEWLINE}where you can buy everything you need.

strings.zh: ３楼是使精灵变强的{NEWLINE}技能机专柜。
strings.en: Third floor has the TM Shop{NEWLINE}to power up your Pokémon.
Fourth floor has the Wiseman Gifts,{NEWLINE}which has the perfect gifts.

strings.zh: ５楼是提高能力的{NEWLINE}药店与果子专柜。
strings.en: Fifth floor has Perfume, Herbs & Berries{NEWLINE}to raise stats.
strings.notes: Floor name matched to the hack's 5F directory (0487 #0, 0491 #3); US said Battle Collection.

strings.zh: ６楼是最顶层,歇脚的{NEWLINE}休闲广场。
strings.en: Sixth floor has the Rooftop Atrium{NEWLINE}for a nice break.
